skill.name: implement
skill.description: Guide an AI coding agent to implement PRDs or issue lists with regular type checks, tests, review, and a final commit.
skill.summary: Implements scoped coding work from PRDs or issues with tests and review.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. I found no semantic evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, or hidden unsafe behavior in SKILL.md.

content.user_title: Implement PRDs and Issues With Tests
content.value_statement: Turning PRDs and issue lists into working code can lose test coverage and review discipline. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through implementation, checks, review, and commit steps.
actual_capabilities: Turns a PRD or issue list into implementation work for an AI coding agent.
Encourages test driven development where practical and agreed in advance.
Directs the agent to run typechecking and focused tests during the work.
Calls for the full test suite at the end of implementation.
Adds a review step before the final commit.
limitations: It does not define project-specific build, test, or typecheck commands.
It requires a clear PRD, issue list, or user-provided scope.
It does not provide executable scripts or automated project analysis.
The final commit instruction may need adjustment for team workflows.

use_cases.title: Implement Product Requirements
use_cases.description: Convert a product requirement document into focused code changes with tests and review.

use_cases.title: Resolve Issue Batches
use_cases.description: Work through selected issues while keeping type checks, focused tests, and final validation in the loop.

use_cases.title: Ship Agent-Assisted Changes
use_cases.description: Guide an AI coding agent from scope intake through implementation, review, and commit.

prompt_templates.title: Implement a PRD
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to implement the attached PRD. Start by summarizing scope, then make the smallest safe changes and run focused tests.

prompt_templates.title: Implement One Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to implement issue #[number]. Confirm the acceptance criteria, update the code, run typechecking, and report the tests run.

prompt_templates.title: Implement Related Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to implement issues #[number] and #[number]. Group related changes, keep tests focused, then run the full suite.

prompt_templates.title: Implement and Prepare Commit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to implement the provided scope. Apply TDD where suitable, review the finished changes, and commit to the current branch.

output_examples.input: Implement a PRD for adding saved filters to the dashboard.
output: Scope summary with key acceptance criteria.
Implemented dashboard changes with focused tests.
Typecheck and full test suite results.
Review notes and final commit summary.

output_examples.input: Implement three linked issues about account settings.
output: Completed settings updates with validation coverage.
Checks run during development and at completion.
Final review findings and commit message.

best_practices: Provide a clear PRD or issue list with acceptance criteria.
Share the project test and typecheck commands before implementation starts.
Review the final diff and test results before relying on the commit.
anti_patterns: Using the skill with vague goals or missing acceptance criteria.
Skipping focused tests until the end of the work.
Treating the final commit as a substitute for human review.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It guides an AI coding agent through implementing work from a PRD or issue list.

faq.question: Does it run code by itself?
faq.answer: No. It is a prompt-only workflow and does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a PRD, issue list, acceptance criteria, and any required project commands.

faq.question: Does it require test driven development?
faq.answer: It asks the agent to use TDD where practical and at agreed implementation points.

faq.question: Will it always commit changes?
faq.answer: The skill asks for a final commit, but users should confirm that this matches their workflow.
